acceptance.given: A disposable package declares a database-write capability and an 'already verified' flag. Independent variants omit the declared record reference, authority reference, or both; unrelated declarations remain valid.

oracle.expected: Each unsupported verification claim causes validation failure. Structured diagnostics identify the applicable rule ID, capability-relative path and diagnostic code. Derived validation evidence retains authorizes=[]. Static checking neither establishes a real backup/restore result nor grants execution authority.
forbidden: An unsupported 'already verified' claim passes validation.
A reference on another capability satisfies this capability's verification claim.
Static validation is counted as a restore drill.
An unconditional-pass validator satisfies the assertions.
oracle.observable: During scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a17, independently marked parameter cases directly call scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package and inspect the owning validation workflow's structured rejection of each unsupported verification claim.

acceptance.then: The owning validation workflow rejects the unreferenced verification flag and reports the affected capability without asserting that a restore drill occurred.
acceptance.when: The actual validator evaluates each database-write capability's verification claim during the targeted A17 check.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a17 with independently marked omission variants bound to this obligation's compiler-assigned assertion IDs. Directly invoke scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package. Expect an observable AssertionError if an unsupported verification claim is accepted or its rejection diagnostic fails to identify the capability. Bound the targeted command to 300 seconds. Missing imports, absent tests, environment errors and timeouts are harness blockers, never causal RED; if the first real production call cannot be established under the current protocol, report that limitation before entering TDD.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Within the cohesive A3 capability-validation context, reject an 'already verified' database-write claim lacking its declared record or authority reference. Consume the existing workflow boundary without implementing a database, backup system, restore executor or new evidence controller.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback only the declared candidate changes. Preserve existing public interfaces and historical evidence; perform no database or live-state mutation. Shared policy/schema/validator changes invalidate affected proofs and require current regression validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unsupported database-write verification claim is submitted to validation, then rejected with a capability-specific diagnostic and no derived authorization.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All A17 omission variants execute against the real callable and satisfy their independently bound assertions; tests reject an unconditional-pass implementation. Freeze tests/helpers before formal RED and restrict implementation changes to declared production owners. Q6 runs a nonempty applicable current/predecessor regression selection. After all required cases are authored and exercised, Q8 runs one current whole-plan selection of the four declared test modules with a 600-second limit; targeted commands have a 300-second limit. Preserve failure history, retain authorizes=[] on derived evidence, and never count static validation as restore-drill proof. Do not reopen completed workflow controllers, publish knowledge, fabricate approvals, or treat a proposed ADR as an initial RED blocker.
